# Transitivity Rules
# Before + Before -> Before
R_Trans_BB: Before(E1, E2) & Before(E2, E3) => Before(E1, E3) [HARD]
# Before + Equal -> Before
R_Trans_BO: Before(E1, E2) & Equal(E2, E3) => Before(E1, E3) [HARD]
# Equal + Before -> Before
R_Trans_OB: Equal(E1, E2) & Before(E2, E3) => Before(E1, E3) [HARD]
# Equal + Equal -> Equal
R_Trans_OO: Equal(E1, E2) & Equal(E2, E3) => Equal(E1, E3) [HARD]
# After + After -> After
R_Trans_AA: After(E1, E2) & After(E2, E3) => After(E1, E3) [HARD]
# After + Equal -> After
R_Trans_AO: After(E1, E2) & Equal(E2, E3) => After(E1, E3) [HARD]
# Equal + After -> After
R_Trans_OA: Equal(E1, E2) & After(E2, E3) => After(E1, E3) [HARD]

# Symmetry Rules
# Before(A,B) -> After(B,A)
R_Symm_BA: Before(E1, E2) => After(E2, E1) [HARD]
# After(A,B) -> Before(B,A)
R_Symm_AB: After(E1, E2) => Before(E2, E1) [HARD]
